prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded. Do you understand and consent to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Great. Can you tell me in your own words what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, turning left onto the main road. I had a green light, but there was a gap in traffic and I started my turn. Then a car coming from the opposite direction hit the front of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked, but it came up fast. I think it may have been speeding or was trying to beat the light.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: Yes, the driver side airbag went off. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the side of the door.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for your injuries?

A: Yes. I was taken by ambulance to the emergency room. They X-rayed my wrist and said it was fractured. I have a cast now and I'm scheduled to see an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else about the accident you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was following the traffic rules and I believe the other driver should have yielded or stopped for the red light. I have photos of my car if you need them.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we've reviewed the information. Is this the best number to reach you?

A: Yes, that works.

Q: Thank you for your time today.

A: You're welcome.
